polaris: LP29-C2T / provenance-complete external joined table construction
framework: A-side OI/Srivastava witness payload requirements and deterministic gate predicates only; this round defines what evidence a future executor must parse before any Srivastava/OI row can move beyond BLOCK. No material validation is performed.

findings.summary: Round 4 responds to the reviewer fatal point by specifying the A-side witness fields required to turn Srivastava/OI blocker labels into reproducible gate decisions. The required payload must carry source_row_id, structure_id, OI_comparison_mode, OI_raw_sum, OI_norm, OI_normalization_formula_id, pair_cutoff_A, pair_density, and fixed-pair denominator witnesses when applicable. Current candidates remain BLOCK because the supplied schema/blocker inputs still show incomplete source-to-structure mapping, missing raw overlap sums, missing exact normalization provenance, and no complete same-sample row.

weakest_link: A-side requirements can specify a PASS transition, but current Srivastava/OI candidate evidence still lacks executable raw-sum, normalization, pair-selection, structure_id, and source_row_id witnesses.

next_plan.goal: Implement a minimal payload parser against C2T_A_witness_requirements_round4.csv without validating materials.
steps: Represent each future Srivastava/OI witness payload as one row or object keyed by source_row_id and structure_id.
Evaluate the OI_comparison_mode gate before any OI calculation claim.
Block Srivastava reproduction unless OI_raw_sum, OI_norm, OI_normalization_formula_id, pair_cutoff_A, source_row_id, and structure_id are all present and mutually consistent.
Block fixed_density mode unless pair_density is present and tied to the same source_row_id, structure_id, and pair selection rule.
Block fixed_pair mode unless OI_pair_mean, N_pair, and N_pair_provenance_id are present and tied to the same counted-pair denominator.
next_plan.stop_condition: Do not promote any current candidate beyond BLOCK until a real payload satisfies every required A-side witness predicate.

claims.statement: A Srivastava/OI witness payload cannot support reproduced-baseline status unless source_row_id, structure_id, OI_raw_sum, OI_norm, OI_normalization_formula_id, and pair_cutoff_A are all populated and mutually provenance-linked.

variables.OI_raw_sum: raw sum over source-defined overlap-bearing pairs
variables.cell_volume_m3: cell or snapshot volume in SI units

limits.desc: Reported OI_norm alone is not Srivastava reproduction.

assumptions: The current task is witness-requirement definition only.
No material validation or graph-vs-OI comparison is allowed from these requirements alone.

claims.statement: Fixed-pair OI mode is auditable only when OI_pair_mean, N_pair, and N_pair_provenance_id are supplied for the same source row, structure, and pair-selection rule as OI_raw_sum.

limits.desc: A numeric denominator without provenance is not an executable witness.

references.label: Inspector A C2T Round 3 residual warnings

assumptions: N_pair is dimensionless and must be derived under the same pair-selection rule as OI_raw_sum.
Failure of this gate blocks fixed_pair mode rather than producing a warning-only status.

reviewer_response.fatal_point: Round 3 had blocker-status labels but no executable witness payload schema, so BLOCK/WARN/PASS was not a reproducible audit decision.
reviewer_response.round4_response: This A-side artifact defines the minimum OI/Srivastava witness fields and pass/block predicates needed by a future executor. It does not claim that payloads are populated.
reviewer_response.scope_boundary: Only A-side OI/Srivastava witness requirements are contributed here; same-sample full joined-table execution and material validation remain out of scope.
reviewer_response.current_conclusion: Current candidates remain BLOCK and Srivastava baseline remains not reproduced.

produced_artifacts.description: A-side OI/Srivastava witness field requirements with gate-level pass and block conditions.
A Round 4 summary and gate predicate contribution for OI/Srivastava witness requirements.

predicates.pass_if: source_row_id and structure_id are present and mutually traceable to the same Srivastava/OI source row or declared reconstruction.
predicates.block_if: Either id is missing or the mapping is ambiguous.

predicates.pass_if: OI_comparison_mode is one of no_claim, fixed_density, fixed_pair, srivastava_reproduction.
predicates.block_if: Mode is missing, unsupported, or changed after label inspection.

predicates.pass_if: source_row_id, structure_id, OI_raw_sum, OI_norm, OI_normalization_formula_id, and pair_cutoff_A are present and mutually consistent.
predicates.block_if: Any required field is missing or provenance-inconsistent.

predicates.pass_if: OI_comparison_mode=fixed_density and pair_density is present with same source_row_id, structure_id, pair_cutoff_A, OI_raw_sum, and OI_norm provenance.
predicates.block_if: pair_density is missing or derived under a different structure or pair rule.

predicates.pass_if: OI_comparison_mode=fixed_pair and OI_pair_mean, N_pair, and N_pair_provenance_id are present and satisfy OI_pair_mean == OI_raw_sum / N_pair within declared tolerance.
predicates.block_if: Any fixed-pair denominator witness is missing or inconsistent.

default_for_current_candidates.reason: The supplied schema/blocker inputs still mark the relevant source, structure, normalization, raw-overlap, and complete-row evidence as missing or partial.
